description: Detect PNG exports whose content is sliced/cut off at the bottom edge (e.g. a Figma export that ended mid-form). Dimension/ratio checks cannot catch cut content inside a correctly-sized file; this measures per-pixel luminance variance in the bottom strip — uniform background = clean, high-variance UI content running into the edge = likely-sliced. Accepts filesystem paths to PNGs.

image_paths.description: Filesystem paths to PNG files to check for sliced/cut-off bottom content.

name: audit_asset_integrity
